# Exploration

*[Rules Glossary](../index.md)*

Resting, carrying gear, breaking things, and the hazards of the wider world.

## Sections

- [Hazards](Hazards/index.md)

## Entries

- [Breaking Objects](Breaking-Objects.md): Objects can be harmed by attacks and by some spells, using the rules below.
- [Carrying Capacity](Carrying-Capacity.md): Your size and Strength score determine the maximum weight in pounds that you can carry, as shown in the Carrying Capacity table.
- [Long Rest](Long-Rest.md): A Long Rest is a period of extended downtime—at least 8 hours—available to any creature.
- [Short Rest](Short-Rest.md): A Short Rest is a 1-hour period of downtime, during which a creature does nothing more strenuous than reading, talking, eating, or standing watch.
